title: Immutable Evaluation diagnostics fail at JSON writing and raw-summary comparison boundaries

evidence.scope: One retained common A/A failure and CPU reproductions. The failed job counted samples but produced no accepted receipt or retained raw sample values. No speed, A/A classification or performance qualification is inferred from counters.

observation: Job maca-bf2a5f7c1235 completed 68 native calls, 2 module loads, 2 preflight calls and counted 20 timing samples, then failed with TypeError: Object of type mappingproxy is not JSON serializable. The first case remained failed, fifteen cases were not submitted, and no attribution ran. EvaluationReceipt recursively freezes nested diagnostics; worker and standalone profile producers carried them across shallow dict copies into ordinary JSON encoding. CPU composition then exposed a second boundary: raw JSON arrays were compared to frozen tuples without the existing JSON projection, so reconstructing an otherwise identical receipt could reject itself.
proposed_change: Reuse evaluation.core._plain_json at the common worker writer before provenance insertion, at the two existing failed-activity payload encoders, at standalone Program profile payload encoding, and on both sides of the receipt/raw-correctness comparison. Keep immutable records, complete diagnostics, CanonicalJSON, oracle and measurement rules unchanged. Do not add a second projection owner or journal.
promotion_disposition: A shared Evaluation protocol repair. No Compiler primitive, Target capability, numerical change, latency result or device qualification is promoted. The separate MetaX aggregate contract repair is F-2026-10-10-003; the integrated attribution test requires both ticks. The original failed A/A is not redrawn.

verified_by.regression_before_fix: b5b910fc reproduces mappingproxy TypeError in paired, untimed, attribution and failed-activity paths. 50895cf6 reproduces rejection when a receipt is reconstructed from its own immutable correctness; nested wire tampering stays rejected.
verified_by.tests: The integrated fixed source passes 45 CPU contracts: twelve immutable-evidence controls, four separate MetaX aggregate controls and twenty-nine adjacent worker/serialization/profile-handoff contracts. Complete nested values, names and order survive; mutation is refused. Allocation provenance treats frozen and plain observations equally while keeping the closed worker envelope unchanged. Unknown values, non-string keys, NaN and infinity are refused. Existing valid canonical bytes are unchanged.
verified_by.boundary_audit: Paired correctness still owns a strict three-scalar aggregate and needs no recursive change. Paired timing already uses its existing recursive canonical projection; frozen receipt reconstruction passes. Pre-freeze task JSON producers were examined without evidence of the same defect and were not mechanically rewritten.
verified_by.scope: Source and CPU only. Linux CPU and final independent review are recorded in the follow-up verification entry. No new GPU, provider or A/A is authorized by this Finding.

verification_updates.environment: Independent Linux CPU checkout in the accepted no-network, no-device, no-key container; original source and failed GPU outputs unchanged.
verification_updates.result: 51/51 CPU contracts passed, zero skips/errors/failures, including the 45 earlier contracts and six MetaX Program profile contracts with actual CPU Torch.
verification_updates.source_custody: New complete detached checkout, no remotes or alternates, clean before and after; imported Compiler path explicitly bound to that checkout.
verification_updates.independent_review: Final read-only source review passed for complete JSON-domain comparison, failure payloads, provenance order and separate MetaX aggregate ownership.
verification_updates.evidence: immutable-evidence-integration-cpu-001/summary.json, tests.stderr, test-command.json and execution.json; mirrored under the software evidence root.
verification_updates.scope: Protocol source/CPU repair verified. No new GPU or A/A attempt; the prior counted-but-unretained samples remain an invalid measurement.
